node.title: Unique-decoding CA/MCA transfer is disjoint from the live rate-half crossing interval
node.statement: For the official rate-half row n=2^41, k=2^40, the unique-decoding MCA-from-CA transfer and the BCIKS correlated-agreement import require 2(n-a)<=n-k, equivalently a>=3n/4. Every live interior agreement k+2^34<=a<3n/4 violates that hypothesis, with failure already equal to two at a=3n/4-1. The transfer recovers the existing half-distance endpoint but cannot supply the live far-CA upper bound. This fences only the named unique-decoding route; it does not rule out a new beyond-half-distance CA/MCA theorem.
